title: Constant complexes of finite $\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$-modules
statement:
For a scheme $W$, let $(-)_W:\mathsf{Mod}_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}\to\mathsf{Sh}(W_{\Et},\mathsf{Mod}_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n})$ send a module $M$ to the sheafification $M_W$ of the constant presheaf with value $M$. By Lemma “Exactness of constant sheaves” (`pur7710-lem-constant-exact`) it is exact; define

$$
c_{W,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}:=\mathrm D\bigl((-)_W\bigr):D(\mathsf{Mod}_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n})\longrightarrow D(W_{\Et},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n),
$$

the levelwise functor.
